items.title: Approve the Minutes of the March 21, 2023 Meeting
Appoint Two Members to the Community Advisory Committee

Adopt Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax Program Guidelines and Program $21,279,740 in Fiscal Years 2022/23 and 2023/24 TNC Tax Funds to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency for Four Projects
Allocate $2,451,857 in Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax Funds, with Conditions, to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency for the FY23 Vision Zero Quick-Build Program (Part 2)

Authorize the Executive Director to Enter into a Funding Agreement with the Metropolitan Transportation Commission for a Total Amount Not to Exceed $270,000 for San Francisco Travel Diary Survey Data Collection

Amend the Adopted Fiscal Year 2022/23 Budget to Increase Revenues by $31,243,544, Decrease Expenditures by $19,121,435 and Decrease Other Financing Sources by $55,000,000 for a Total Net Decrease in Fund Balance of $856
Approve the Revised Administrative Code and the Debt; Equal Benefits; Investment; Rules of Order; and Sunshine Policies
